svg.title: multiply the Bianchi equation by F c ai, sum, and interchange a, i in its second derivative term to obtain the factor two on the left and the half derivative on the right. This cancels the divergence of the subtracted term in (FM6). Evaluation on all real solution towers then proves the polynomial identity. Through (FM4) it gives a real, symmetric, conserved free field at horizon four, with the exact normalization used in the later free comparison.
